points.title: 童年与教育
points.description: 泰戈尔出生于加尔各答一个富裕的婆罗门家庭，是第十四个孩子。他的父亲德本德拉纳特·泰戈尔是宗教改革家和社会活动家。泰戈尔从小接受传统印度教育，同时也接触西方文学和思想。1873年，父亲带他旅行，使他接触到印度各地的自然风光和多元文化，这对他后来的创作产生了深远影响。1878年，他前往英国学习法律，但中途辍学，转向文学创作。
points.descriptionEn: Born into a wealthy Brahmin family in Kolkata, Tagore was the fourteenth child. His father, Debendranath Tagore, was a religious reformer and social activist. Tagore received traditional Indian education while also being exposed to Western literature and thought. In 1873, his father took him on travels across India, exposing him to diverse natural landscapes and cultures, which profoundly influenced his later works. In 1878, he went to England to study law but dropped out to focus on literary creation.

points.title: 文学创作起步
points.description: 回到印度后，泰戈尔开始专注于文学创作。1882年，他发表了第一部诗集《黄昏之歌》，展现了他独特的诗歌风格。1883年，他与比他小9岁的结婚，妻子成为他创作的重要灵感来源。1884-1890年，他担任家族杂志《婆罗多》的编辑，发表了许多重要作品。这一时期，他创作了《故事诗》(1886)和《金帆船》(1894)等作品，奠定了他在印度文学界的地位。1890年，他管理家族在吉大港的庄园，这段经历丰富了他的创作素材。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to India, Tagore focused on literary creation. In 1882, he published his first collection of poems, 'Evening Songs', showcasing his unique poetic style. In 1883, he married a woman nine years younger than him, who became an important source of inspiration for his works. From 1884 to 1890, he edited the family magazine 'Bharati', publishing many significant works. During this period, he created 'Story Poems' (1886) and 'The Golden Boat' (1894), establishing his position in Indian literature. In 1890, he managed the family estate in Shilaidaha, which enriched his creative materials.

points.title: 教育实验
points.description: 泰戈尔在父亲留下的桑地尼克坦庄园创办了一所学校，后来发展成为著名的维斯瓦·巴拉蒂大学。这所学校融合了东西方教育理念，强调与自然的联系和创造性思维。1905年，印度民族运动兴起，泰戈尔积极参与，创作了许多爱国诗歌和歌曲，包括后来成为印度国歌的《金色的孟加拉》。1909年，他创作了长篇小说《戈拉》，探讨了印度民族身份和文化认同问题。1910年，他创作了著名诗集《吉檀迦利》，这部作品后来被他自己翻译成英文，为他赢得了国际声誉。
points.descriptionEn: Tagore established a school at the Shantiniketan estate left by his father, which later developed into the famous Visva-Bharati University. This school integrated Eastern and Western educational philosophies, emphasizing connections with nature and creative thinking. In 1905, with the rise of the Indian nationalist movement, Tagore actively participated, creating many patriotic poems and songs, including 'Amar Shonar Bangla', later Bangladesh's national anthem. In 1909, he wrote the novel 'Gora', exploring Indian national identity and cultural questions. In 1910, he created the famous collection 'Gitanjali', which he later translated into English, bringing him international recognition.

points.title: 世界声誉
points.description: 1912年，泰戈尔带着《吉檀迦利》的英译本前往英国，结识了罗素、爱因斯坦等著名知识分子，作品引起轰动。1913年，他成为第一位获得诺贝尔文学奖的亚洲人，被誉为'东方的智者'。此后，他频繁访问欧美各国，传播印度文化和哲学思想。1921年，他访问中国，与中国知识分子如徐志摩、梁启超等人交流，对中国现代文学产生深远影响。这一时期，他创作了《飞鸟集》(1916)和《园丁集》(1918)等作品，这些作品被翻译成多种语言，在世界范围内广为流传。
points.descriptionEn: In 1912, Tagore traveled to England with the English translation of 'Gitanjali', meeting famous intellectuals like Bertrand Russell and Albert Einstein, causing a sensation. In 1913, he became the first Asian to receive the Nobel Prize in Literature, hailed as 'the wise man of the East'. Thereafter, he frequently visited Europe and America, spreading Indian culture and philosophical ideas. In 1921, he visited China, exchanging ideas with Chinese intellectuals such as Xu Zhimo and Liang Qichao, profoundly influencing modern Chinese literature. During this period, he created works like 'Stray Birds' (1916) and 'The Gardener' (1918), which were translated into many languages and widely circulated worldwide.

points.title: 晚年创作
points.description: 回到桑地尼克坦后，泰戈尔继续创作了大量作品，包括长篇小说《四个人》(1934)和《家庭与世界》(1936)，以及诗集《最后的诗篇》(1938)。1924年，他访问苏联，对社会主义思想产生兴趣，但后来对斯大林主义持批评态度。1930年，他再次访问欧洲和美国，与爱因斯坦等人就科学与宗教的关系进行对话。这一时期，他的创作更加关注社会问题和人类命运，作品风格也更加深沉和哲理化。他还积极参与印度独立运动，但主张非暴力抵抗，与甘地理念相近。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to Shantiniketan, Tagore continued to create numerous works, including novels 'Four Chapters' (1934) and 'The Home and the World' (1936), as well as the poetry collection 'Last Poems' (1938). In 1924, he visited the Soviet Union, developing an interest in socialist ideas but later criticizing Stalinism. In 1930, he visited Europe and America again, engaging in dialogues with Einstein and others on the relationship between science and religion. During this period, his works focused more on social issues and human destiny, with a deeper and more philosophical style. He also actively participated in the Indian independence movement, advocating nonviolent resistance, similar to Gandhi's philosophy.

points.title: 最后岁月
points.description: 1937年，泰戈尔健康状况恶化，但仍坚持创作。1938年，他创作了最后一部诗集《恢复》。1940年，他完成了自传《我的回忆》。1941年8月7日，泰戈尔在加尔各答逝世，享年80岁。他的去世被视为印度文化的一大损失。泰戈尔一生创作了50多部诗集、12部小说、20多部剧本、100多篇短篇小说和大量散文、哲学著作，以及2000多首歌曲。他的作品被翻译成多种语言，对世界文学产生了深远影响。他的教育理念至今仍在印度和世界各地影响着教育实践。
points.descriptionEn: In 1937, Tagore's health deteriorated, but he continued to create. In 1938, he wrote his final poetry collection 'Restoration'. In 1940, he completed his autobiography 'My Reminiscences'. On August 7, 1941, Tagore passed away in Kolkata at the age of 80. His death was seen as a great loss to Indian culture. Throughout his life, Tagore created over 50 poetry collections, 12 novels, more than 20 plays, over 100 short stories, and numerous essays and philosophical works, as well as more than 2000 songs. His works have been translated into many languages and have profoundly influenced world literature. His educational philosophy continues to influence educational practices in India and around the world.

supporter.zh: 泰戈尔被誉为'印度的灵魂'和'东方的智者'，他是印度现代文学的奠基人，将印度传统文化推向世界舞台。他的诗歌融合了东西方哲学思想，展现了人类精神的普遍性。作为教育家，他创立的维斯瓦·巴拉蒂大学成为东西方文化交流的重要平台。泰戈尔的作品超越了民族和文化的界限，关注人类共同命运，体现了深刻的人道主义精神。他的非暴力理念和对多元文化的尊重，为世界和平与和谐提供了宝贵思想资源。
supporter.en: Tagore is hailed as 'the soul of India' and 'the wise man of the East.' He is the founder of modern Indian literature, bringing traditional Indian culture to the world stage. His poetry integrates Eastern and Western philosophical thoughts, demonstrating the universality of the human spirit. As an educator, the Visva-Bharati University he founded became an important platform for East-West cultural exchange. Tagore's works transcend national and cultural boundaries, focusing on humanity's common destiny, embodying profound humanitarian spirit. His philosophy of nonviolence and respect for multiculturalism provides valuable intellectual resources for world peace and harmony.

critic.zh: 泰戈尔的作品也面临一些批评。有评论家认为他的诗歌过于理想化，脱离了印度社会的现实困境。在政治立场上，他有时被批评为摇摆不定，既支持民族独立又与殖民当局保持联系。他的教育理念被一些人批评为过于精英主义，脱离印度大众的实际需求。此外，他的某些作品中的女性形象被批评为刻板化，反映了当时社会的性别偏见。泰戈尔对西方文化的复杂态度也受到质疑，他既批判西方殖民主义，又欣赏西方艺术和思想，这种矛盾性使他成为一些激进民族主义者的批评对象。
critic.en: Tagore's works have also faced criticism. Some critics argue that his poetry is overly idealized, detached from the real困境 of Indian society. Politically, he was sometimes criticized for being inconsistent, supporting national independence while maintaining connections with colonial authorities. His educational philosophy was criticized by some as elitist, detached from the actual needs of the Indian masses. Additionally, female characters in some of his works were criticized as stereotypical, reflecting the gender biases of contemporary society. Tagore's complex attitude toward Western culture has also been questioned; while he criticized Western colonialism, he also appreciated Western art and thought, making him a target for criticism from some radical nationalists.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，泰戈尔被定义为一位跨文化的文学巨匠和教育改革家。他的作品被广泛研究，被视为后殖民文学的重要先驱。泰戈尔的形象超越了单纯的文学家，成为印度文化软实力的象征。他的诗歌和歌曲在印度和孟加拉国被广泛传唱，其中《金色的孟加拉》成为孟加拉国的国歌，《人民的意志》成为印度的国歌。在全球化时代，泰戈尔的跨文化思想和人文主义精神被重新发现，成为应对文化冲突和促进文明对话的重要资源。他的教育理念对当代教育改革仍有启示意义，强调创造性思维和与自然的联系。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Tagore is defined as a cross-cultural literary giant and educational reformer. His works are widely studied as important precursors to postcolonial literature. Tagore's image transcends that of a mere writer, becoming a symbol of India's soft power. His poems and songs are widely sung in India and Bangladesh, with 'Amar Shonar Bangla' becoming Bangladesh's national anthem and 'Jana Gana Mana' India's national anthem. In the era of globalization, Tagore's cross-cultural ideas and humanistic spirit have been rediscovered as important resources for addressing cultural conflicts and promoting civilizational dialogue. His educational philosophy continues to inspire contemporary educational reforms, emphasizing creative thinking and connections with nature.

self.zh: 天空不曾留下鸟的痕迹，但我已飞过。
self.en: The sky leaves no tracks of the birds flying, but I have flown.

others.zh: 泰戈尔的诗歌以其深刻的情感和优美的形式，揭示了人类灵魂的普遍真理。
others.en: Tagore's poetry, with its profound emotion and beautiful form, reveals the universal truths of the human soul.
